card.name: Words after start, begin, first, get
card.fires_on: The word right after a beginning-type verb or adverb such as setting, start, first, or get, in general web prose about starting something. It marks the point where a start or opening is being described.

modes.label: After start-type verbs
modes.description: A word following a verb of starting or setting off, such as out or early.
modes.example: Princeton's newest undergraduates are setting<< out>> on a path of inquiry and discovery this

modes.label: After first or initial
modes.description: A word following first or a start-up phrase, describing the initial stage of something.
modes.example: Soybean seeds have their highest yield potential, of course, when first<< planted>>.
